thread:
morgan: Flagging a weird parity failure that bit a demo today. Our onboarding sample app uses REST to create a deploy with an extra feature flag field `experimental: true` and the canary picks the new model. The Node SDK sample silently drops that field so customers see the stable model instead.

morgan: curl repro (works):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/deploys \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large","version":"v2","rollout":10, "experimental": true }'
# => 200 {"deploy_id":"d_123","variant":"v2-experimental"}
```

morgan: Node SDK (no experimental):
```
await client.createDeploy({ model: 'gpt-large', version: 'v2', rollout: 10, experimental: true })
// server sees body: { model: 'gpt-large', version: 'v2', rollout: 10 }
// => returns variant: "v2" (no canary)
```

lee: I traced it quickly. The Node SDK has a thin serializer that filters keys against the typed model shape to avoid accidental payloads. The intention was safety, but in this case the server treats unknown keys as feature toggles.

lee: Sniffed request from sample app:
```
POST /v1/deploys
Body: { model: 'gpt-large', version: 'v2', rollout: 10 }
```

samir: Oof. CS reported a live demo where the canary never rolled out. They were toggling `experimental` in the UI and expected SDK-demo parity.

devex-bot: Linked GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/issues/945 (body-key-filtering drops feature flags). Auto-assigned to @lee.

qa-bot: nightly-e2e-1759999000 -> failed (deploy-parity). Trace id: tr_deploy_9a2.

lee: Proposed fixes: 1) stop aggressive filtering for top-level deploy/create routes and allow passthrough of unknown keys 2) add an explicit `extra` typed bag in the SDK signature for deploys so callers can pass flags safely.

morgan: Workaround for demo: call REST or set `client._opts.allowUnknown = true` in sample app. I'll update the quickstart docs with the REST snippet for now.

samir: Can we add a server-side compatible migration: also read `experimental` from `metadata.flags.experimental` so older SDKs that put things nested still trigger canary?

lee: I'll coordinate with backend about accepting both shapes. Meanwhile I'll open the SDK PR to add `extra` bag and a unit test asserting unknown keys are preserved when `allowUnknown` is true.

devex-bot: CI job ci/77890 queued for PR run.

morgan: Thanks. Please post here when a patch is published so I can tell CS. This one affects pilot customers and our onboarding checklist.

lee: Will do. Marking P2 but bumping if more demos surface this week.
